title: fix(spec)!: refuse a record:activity feed whose types leaves out comment while its comment composer is on
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9G9TiA7wsxpQhP3i3ZacJtB)_
Fixes #34383

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #34534

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:活动块(`record:activity`,以及 `record:chatter` / `record:discussion` 的 `feed`)写了 `types` 却不含 `comment`、同时评论框开着(`showCommentInput` 没写成 `false`)时，编写期直接拒收，报错写明两种改法。
- **为什么改**:`types` 是要显示的条目种类白名单,`comment` 也是其中一种;漏了它，评论框照常收评论，评论存下后又被同一个白名单滤掉，用户以为帖子丢了(HotCRM 线索页 `lead_activity` 就是这样)。渲染端上一张卡已收掉评论框，这张卡在写的地方就拦下。
- **风险与回滚**:收窄(BREAKING),只影响上述组合;没写 `types`、`types` 含 `comment`、或 `showCommentInput: false` 的块完全不变。仓内首方页面零命中;HotCRM `lead_detail` 需加 `'comment'`(另行修)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`(新拒收函数 `refuseFeedTypesWithoutCommentBesideComposer` 及挂在 `RecordActivityProps` 上的一行);`packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts`(9 个新钉子与一处被迫改的旧用例);`.changeset/34383-record-activity-types-without-comment.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/component.test.ts -t 34383`,预期 9 个全过。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The refusal.** `RecordActivityProps` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) gains one object-level check, `refuseFeedTypesWithoutCommentBesideComposer`: when `types` is present, does not contain `'comment'`, and `showCommentInput` is not `false` (absent reads as its default `true`), the parse adds one `custom` issue at `showCommentInput` naming both fixes (located on the composer the list rules out: `types` on its own stays valid, and an issue at `types` would read, to the console's per-key member probe, as the list itself being refused — the Test UI red of round 1) — add `'comment'` to `types`, or set `showCommentInput: false`. The check is unexported, so the console mirror's census of exported `check*` functions does not move; the mirror carries it on the cloned def, and reads an absent `showCommentInput` as on, the same as the spec.

**Form.** The card left the form to the spec lane. A schema check, not a new lint rule: `ComponentPropsMap['record:activity']` is the row `component-props-invalid` (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts`) already judges every page's `properties` with, at error, on `os lint` / `os validate` / `os build` and the runtime page door it is registered on. So one check reaches every door with no second rule to keep in step.

**Both mounts.** `RecordActivityProps` is also `RecordChatterProps.feed` (`record:chatter` and `record:discussion`), whose renderer filters its rows with the same `applyFeedConfig(…, { types, … })` call, so the contradiction holds there too, and the message is written to be true on both mounts.

**What it does not judge.** An absent `types` (every kind), any entry against the built-in kinds (the open-vocabulary ruling stands), or a `types` that already failed its own element check (a non-string entry keeps its one issue). Matching is exact, as the renderers match.

**Riders.** Two describes (`types`, `showCommentInput`) state the rule, regenerated into `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` by `gen:docs`. `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains the two sites the build named (`ui/RecordActivityProps` root, `ui/RecordChatterProps` `feed`; measured counts +2 / +2). ADR-0087 D3 entry `record-activity-types-without-comment-beside-composer-refused` (no conversion: which fix the author meant is a judgement about the block). Changeset `minor` on `@objectstack/spec`, registered.

**Forced test change, named.** `component.test.ts` › "does not reject a typo of a built-in kind by name" parsed `{ types: ['commnet'] }` with the composer on by default, which this card now refuses on its own account. The fixture gains `showCommentInput: false` so the case still reads the open vocabulary alone; its assertion is unchanged.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts`, top-level `describe` "RecordActivityProps — a `types` that leaves out comment is refused while the composer is on", 9 cases:

- refused shapes, each asserting one issue at `showCommentInput` with code `custom` and none under `types`: the measured producer (`types: ['task'], limit: 20, showCompleted: true`), explicit `showCommentInput: true`, contributed kinds only, an empty list, a cased `'Comment'`;
- the two fixed shapes (`'comment'` added; `showCommentInput: false`) and an absent `types` with the composer on or off — all accepted;
- a non-string entry keeps exactly its own `types.0` issue; an unknown key still gets `unrecognized_keys` beside the new check;
- the `record:activity` row of `ComponentPropsMap` is this object, and `record:chatter` / `record:discussion` refuse the same shape at `feed.showCommentInput` and accept it with the composer off.

## Why

A `record:activity` (or a chatter feed) that hides comments but keeps the composer takes posts it never shows. The renderer half (previous card) withholds the composer; this card makes the contradiction loud where it is written, so the producer fixes its page instead of the screen quietly differing from what was authored.

## Acceptance notes

- Stored-row detector (`refused-shapes.ts`): dropped — no installed page measured carrying this shape (HotCRM read too), the save gate refuses it loudly, and most step-18 refusal entries have no detector.
- **Renderer gap on the chatter mount (noted, not fixed here).** The `record:activity` renderer withholds the composer and the Comments-only option on such a feed; the `record:chatter` / `record:discussion` renderer does not (`RecordChatterPanel` hands its timeline no `commentsShown`, so it defaults to `true`). After this change an authored page cannot reach it; a host composing the panel in code still can. Reported to the seat.
- HotCRM `lead_detail.lead_activity` (`types: ['task']`) will be refused on its next save; producer fix is hotcrm's, held for the maintainer.
- The HTTP page door was not driven end-to-end here: the reach is the rule's registration on the runtime door plus the `validateComponentProps` reading below.

## Verification

Run on head `bf199627` (branch merged with `origin/main` at `1efe7a22` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`; main had moved `packages/spec` with #34267, and after the spec rebuild `check:generated` was clean with nothing to commit). CI on this head: every required context green (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Type Check UI, Test UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate; Lint UI skipped), Check Changeset green.

<details><summary>Round 2: the Test UI red on the first head, and its fix</summary>

On `1533b264`, Test UI (1/16) went red in `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` (2 cases): the console's member probe parses `{ types: [x] }` alone, the composer defaulted on, and the issue sat AT `types` (path length 1), which the probe reads as the container itself being refused (`no-member-position`). The issue now sits at `showCommentInput`; the same file on `bf199627`: 261/261 passed, no `ui/**` change.
</details>

<details><summary>Spec tests, typecheck, ablation</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` on `bf199627` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 846 passed (846), Tests 27090 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/component.test.ts -t 34383`: 9 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (first head); `check:test-typecheck` in the gate round below.
- Ablation on `bf199627` (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, src is what the test resolves): anchor `.superRefine(refuseFeedTypesWithoutCommentBesideComposer)` replaced by a marker comment, mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed). Result: 4 failed, 5 passed — every refusal pin red, the five acceptance pins green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Reach through the lint gate (one-off reading on bf199627, not committed)</summary>

`validateComponentProps` from `packages/lint/src` over a record page with a `record:activity` block and a `record:discussion` block:
- `{ types: ['task'], limit: 20, showCompleted: true }`: two findings, both `severity: error`, `rule: component-props-invalid`, at `pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.showCommentInput` and `components[1].properties.feed.showCommentInput`, message naming both fixes.
- `{ types: ['task','comment'] }`, `{ types: ['task'], showCommentInput: false }`, `{}`: no findings.

A whole `PageSchema.safeParse` of the same page stays clean: the page parse does not judge `properties`; the lint rule is that door.
</details>

<details><summary>Gate round (dispatch-gates, 115 families, bf199627)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `bf199627` derived 115 families; all 115 run, 115 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 115 derived, 115 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood battery (bf199627)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 478 passed, 3 skipped (481), Tests 4030 passed, 44 skipped (4074), no failure. (The first head's battery read the same counts.)
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run, not run locally.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
